description: Defines the PdfName class representing a PDF name value, including methods for creation, comparison, and string manipulation within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PdfName
classes.description: Represents a PDF name value, providing constructors, comparison operators, and utility methods for handling PDF name strings.

classes.name: PdfXNameComparer
classes.description: Implements comparison logic for PdfName objects.

methods.name: PdfName()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the name to an empty name ('/').

methods.name: PdfName(string value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the name with a string starting with '/'. Throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: GetHashCode()
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the name value.

methods.name: AddSlash(string value)
methods.description: Ensures the string starts with a slash.

methods.name: RemoveSlash(string value)
methods.description: Removes the leading slash from the string if present.

methods.name: FromString(string value)
methods.description: Creates a PdfName from a string not starting with '/'.
